scope: source-packet active-box alignment tolerance; no OCR, extraction, key derivation, hashing, seed/WIF checks, address checks, BIP39 checks, or broad candidate generation

decision.reason: The active boxes have a narrow common tolerance window: all targets survive +4px outward padding, -12px inset, and +/-4px all-direction shifts, but larger padding/shifts begin to break black-highlight and orange-highlight classification. This constrains future source matching and supplies no extraction unit/order.

nextMove: For any physical scan, original layout export, or fresh PDF extraction, first align to the native bridge and require the active boxes to meet these tolerance benchmarks; then require R3 unit/order evidence before extraction.
